scope_and_isolation.note: Stage B (Apple M5 Ultra 80-core 256GB) requires its own m5-ultra-80gpu-256g calibration and static dispatch table upon arrival.

memory_and_icb_rules.reason: Apple Silicon MTLIndirectComputeCommand truncates offsets >= 4 GiB silently without API validation; capping weight segments at 2 GiB + SharedPrimary per-slot buffer sharing + cyclic feature_history ring + FOSCAR Affine4Group128 KV unlocks B=8@64K (24.5 GiB) and B=4@128K (23.8 GiB) on 96GB UMA.

linear_row_exact.mxfp4_kernel: omlx_m5_row_exact_mxfp4 (v3: 8-group 128B coalesced uint + bfloat4, zero inner-loop SIMD shuffle)
linear_row_exact.oq_affine_kernel: omlx_m5_row_exact_q{3,4,5,6,8}_g{64,128} (v4: adds QDA q3_g64/q3_g128 + half-register s*c + coalesced bfloat2/bfloat4)

attention.exact_optimization: occupancy-guarded GQA shared K/V tile (active when total_tgs >= 64) + FlashNaxV1 (#4808) prefill (T >= 64, -1994 ms at 8K) + FOSCAR Affine4Group128 zero-mean scale/bias paged KV (4.27x smaller KV with 100% AR==DFlash2==Batch parity)

gdn_prefill.conv1d_kernel: 2D coalesced conv1d + TB=8 register-tiled WY chunk scan

bounded_batch.packed_execution: run_packed_batch (cross-slot single-weight-read B*W NAX forward across shared linear/MLP/MoE weights with per-slot paged attention & GDN state) + replay_icb_batch for Draft & Commit
bounded_batch.contended_prefill_scheduler: #5164 <=45 ms decode-protect chunk scheduler preserving pos%1024==0 coupled contract (24.53 ms active decode p50 ITL under 2048-tok contending prefill)
bounded_batch.shared_prefix_cache: global COW SharedPrefixCache across all B slots (100% B=4 hit rate, 633.89 ms warm B=4 TTFT)

moe_routing.decode_swiglu_kernel: omlx_m5_mxfp4_moe_w4a16_swiglu_grouped & omlx_m5_oq_q{4,5,6,8}_g{64,128}_moe_swiglu_grouped (128B coalesced, zero inner-loop shuffle; fastest at B=1 T=1: 138.24 tok/s)
moe_routing.prefill_nax_kernels: omlx_m5_moe_mxfp4_nax_prepare_t32 + swiglu_bm8_bn16_sk2 + down_scatter_bm8_bn16_sk2_nsg2 (fused NSG=2 2xBN16 down+scatter, zero weight repack, used for T>=8 prefill & B>=2 packed batch)

nax_native_kernels.mxfp4_w4a16_library: omlx_m5_mxfp4_nax.metallib (BM=8, BN=16/32, BK=128, RF=1 default when SK>1, direct-F16 SwiGLU->down_proj fusion; zero-repack with mx_nax_tiled_bk128_v1)
nax_native_kernels.mxfp4_w4a4_prefill: omlx_m5_mxfp4_w4a4_nax_n{16,32}_sk{1,2,4,8} + swiglu (BM=16, T >= 32, explicit gate OMLX_M5_ALLOW_W4A4_PREFILL=1, 1504.30 ms @ 1K, 1471.75 ms with FlashNaxV1)
nax_native_kernels.affine_oq_library: omlx_m5_affine_nax.metallib (Q3/Q4/Q5/Q6 G64 & G128 BM=8, BN=16/32, uint4b+uint2b + fused SwiGLU; zero-repack with oq_nax_tiled_g{64,128}_v1 saving 14.4 GiB on 27B-oQ4e)
nax_native_kernels.bf16_library: omlx_m5_bf16_nax.metallib (direct_bf16_v1 zero-repack BM=8, BN=16, SK=4 + fused SwiGLU + FP32-output selector_nax_f32)
nax_native_kernels.t_domain_dispatch: explicit gate OMLX_M5_T_DOMAIN_DISPATCH=1 routes T=1 pure AR to row_exact v3 SIMD QMV (48.80 tok/s on 27B-MXFP4); default off to preserve 100% AR==DFlash2 coupled parity

speculative_dflash2.adaptive_controller: AdaptiveSpecController (SpecSearch survival S(1..K) + DraftDepth plain_guard + P12 MoE U(M) goodput allocator; --spec-search auto/on/off)
speculative_dflash2.draft_optimizations: single-ICB fused (context_gather + context_kv_append + 5-layer bf16_nax backbone + selector_nax_f32 + 32-SIMDgroup selector_finish) + O(1) feature_epoch + 32B tokens_only readback (draft_gpu 8.98 -> 7.42 ms, verify_gpu 26.54 -> 24.86 ms)

legacy_diagnostic_h1_l_winners.note: Measured on real 27B/35B weights for diagnostic/legacy route reference; production position_coupled_v1 uses native M5 NAX + row_exact v4 above.
